subject: POC scouting: success metrics, owners & proposed kickoff window
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Knox <evelyn@scout-tech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-20T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC scouting: success metrics, owners & proposed kickoff window

Hi Evelyn — great call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight POC plan so we can align on scope and owners. TL;DR: 3-week technical POC, 2 success criteria (latency/cost + quality), pre-kickoff tech check, weekly 30m syncs.

Call highlights (from our side):
- Primary use case: in-product summarization across internal support tickets (short-form, 1–3 paragraphs).
- Key constraints: no persistent customer data on hosted logs; must support per-request redaction.
- Target latency: median <= 250ms for 256-token responses (target end-to-end).
- Desired qualitative target: human-rating >= 4/5 on 50-sample blind eval using your rubric.

Proposed POC (high level):
1) Week 0 (pre-kickoff): tech-check and network test (we'll provide endpoint, Neha will run connectivity).
2) Week 1: baseline integration + 10 sample prompts + daily smoke tests.
3) Week 2: scale to 100 samples, evaluate quality + latency; iterate prompt/template.
4) Week 3: run blind eval and deliver report + recommendation.

Owners:
- Redwood: Karthik (eng lead, program owner), Neha (SE, tech contact), Monica (CS, success criteria owner)
- ScoutTech: Evelyn (POC lead), Paul (engineering), Procurement (proc onboarding)

Attachments: POC-success-metrics-worksheet.xlsx (proposed metrics + evaluation rubric). Please confirm the success criteria below and whether you can commit to providing 100 de-identified example tickets by start of Week 1.

Next steps: can we lock a 45-minute kickoff on either Wed 2027-02-24 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu 2027-02-25 14:00–14:45 PT? I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm.

Thanks — excited to get started.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119

[Attachment: POC-success-metrics-worksheet.xlsx]

From: Evelyn Knox <evelyn@scout-tech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Rivera <paul.rivera@scout-tech.com>, Procurement <procurement@scout-tech.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T17:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC scouting: success metrics, owners & proposed kickoff window

Karthik — thanks for the thorough recap. This aligns with what we discussed. A few quick notes from our side:

- We can provide 100 de-identified tickets but need to confirm the redaction format (we use a custom JSON schema).
- Security: our InfoSec lead asked about data retention on your hosted environment and whether logs can be disabled for the POC.
- Timeline: end-of-quarter pressure on our roadmap; we'd prefer to start the tech-check this week if possible.

Either Wed 2/24 at 10 PT works for us (preferred). I'll loop in Procurement for any contract/PO items they need.

Evelyn
Evelyn Knox
Head of Product | ScoutTech
evelyn@scout-tech.com | +1 (646) 222-3344

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Knox <evelyn@scout-tech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-21T09:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC scouting: success metrics, owners & proposed kickoff window

Evelyn — welcome, and quick answers to InfoSec/prep items so the E2E plan is clear.

1) Data retention: for hosted POCs we offer a "no-logs" option where request/response payloads are not persisted beyond the request lifecycle. We can enable that for your account during the POC and document the setting.
2) Redaction: we accept JSON with your schema; we'll provide a short pre-processing snippet (Python) to map fields. Monica can validate a 5-sample export to confirm.
3) Network: attaching a one-page network-requirements.pdf — we need an outbound TLS 1.2 allowlist for our ingress IPs and a small NAT timeout change for long-poll streaming.

Tech-check: I can do a 30-minute tech-check Tue 2/23 11:00 PT or Wed 2/24 09:00 PT if you want to validate connectivity before kickoff.

On perf: we'll initially serve on a quantized variant to keep cost down; we'll surface latency targets in the kickoff and run a baseline of 50 synthetic requests to set expectations.

— Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (510) 555-0202

[Attachment: network-requirements.pdf]

Thanks everyone for the quick replies — confirming kickoff for Wed 2027-02-24 at 10:00 PT (45m). Calendar invite sent. Agenda: intros, scope review, tech-check ownership, and immediate next 7 days.

Quick housekeeping/items I promised to follow up on:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654 (I've attached the POC metrics sheet to the deal).
- Procurement: if Procurement needs a master services addendum (MSA) or PO template, loop procurement@redwood.ai and I'll get legal on a short review.
- Weekly check-ins: propose 30 minute cadence on Fridays during the POC (standing invite after kickoff).

If anyone from ScoutTech wants Neha to do the tech-check earlier today, she is available at 16:00 PT. Otherwise we'll do the baseline tests in the kickoff and run the synthetic tests by EOD Thursday.

— Karthik
